tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lam 'bras brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dngos grub bsam 'phel bzhugs so// na mo gu ru a nan+da rat+na shri he badz+rā ya/ 'dir gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la snying nas gsol ba 'debs pa dngos grub bsam 'phel zhes bya ba/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i dges pa rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku bzhi dbang phyug rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang / /shes rab sgyu ma'i gar bsgyur bdag med ma/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug dpal ldan chos skyong la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa mthar phyin kar+ṇa pa/ /dngos grub mchog brnyes ḍā ma ru pa'i zhabs/ /gnyis spangs mthar phyin a wa dhu ti la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyi rlobs/ /gangs can kun 'dul ga ya dha ra dang / /skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po shākya'i mtshan/ /rgyud dang man ngag kun 'dzin se ston la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /sbas pa'i rnal 'byor chen po dgon pa ba/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid kun dga' snying po'i zhabs/ /mkhyen rab mthar phyin bsod nams rtse mo la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyi rlobs/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtsug rgyan grags pa'i mtshan/ /rig pa'i gnas lnga mthar phyin paṇ+ḍi ta/ /'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyi rlobs/ /de sras mthu bo zhang ston dkon mchog dpal/ /sgrub pa mthar phyin rgyal ba brag phug pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyi rlobs/ /gdams pa rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag dpal tshul zhabs/ /rtse mo'i yon tan phul byung budha shri/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa kun dga' bzang po la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyi rlobs/ /byang chub thugs 'byongs dkon mchog rgyal mtshan pa/ /nyams rtogs bdag nyid kun dga' dbang phyug zhabs/

/shes bya kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyi rlobs/ /mkhas grub chen po yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ /rlung sems dbang thob sangs rgyas rin chen zhabs/ /'jam mgon ngo bo kun dga' bsod nams la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyi rlobs/ /sku bzhi'i bdag nyid sngags 'chang chen po dang / /grub pa'i dbang phyug dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i zhabs/ /mkhyen brtse'i nus ldan a wa dhu ti la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyi rlabs/ /dngos grub mchog stsol yi dam lha yi tshogs/ /bar chad myur sel mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang / /dam tshig gtsang ma'i mched lcam ma lus la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /de ltar bla ma yi dam chos skyong la/ /rtag tu gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /gsol ba 'debs so skyabs mchog bla ma rnams/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ ma dag pa'i snang ba /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho thog mtha' med pa ru/ /nyon mongs las kyi rlung gis dbang med bdas/ /thar dus med pa'i sdug bsngal 'dam byings ba'i/ /'gro rnams myur du sgrol bar byin gyis rlobs/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal /ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal drag po dang / 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal /mtho ris gsum gyi bde ba ltar snang sogs/ /'du byed kyi sdug bsngal zin med las kyis g.yengs par gyur rnams la/ /zhen log snying nas skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' /mi khom brgyad spangs 'byor ba bcu dang ldan/ /mi lus rin chen lan cig thob dus 'di/ /gnya' shing bu gar rus sbal mgrin chud ltar/ /yang yang dkon pa dran par byin gyis rlobs/ rnyed pa phan thogs che ba /mtho ris thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa ni/ /'gro ba gzhan du skyes na skal ba med/ /dal 'byor kho na las gzhan mi 'grub pas/

/thar pa'i don chen bsgrub par byin gyis rlobs/ thob pa'i dal ba yun du mi gnas pa /'dus byas skad cig mi rtag 'gyur zhing 'jig /sems can skye 'chi nyin mtshan 'khor lo 'dra/ /tshe 'di'i snang ba bar snang glog 'dra bas/ /mi rtag rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ nges par 'chi ba bsams pa /gces par bzung ba'i lus sems dbang med bral/ /kha drag gnyen dang zas nor shul du lus/ /gcig pur gshin rjes bar dor myur du khrid/ /'chi ba'i 'jigs pa dran par byin gyis rlobs/ nam 'chi cha med bsam pa /lus 'di rlung gis btab pa'i chu lbur bzhin/ /'chi rkyen sna tshogs mang po drag la myur/ /'chi bdag bdud po nam yong mi nges pas/ /long med rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ 'chi ba'i dus chos ma yin pa gang gis kyang mi phan pa /zhen pas bsags pa'i zas nor gzhan gyis spyod/ /bskyangs pa'i 'khor gyis gnod pa skyel ba mang / /rtag rtsis 'bad kyang bslu bas snying po med/ /dgos med rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ tshe 'di la zhen pa spangs ba /dgra gnyen 'dul skyong 'jig rten shom ra yid/ /zin med bya bas mi tshe grab la 'dzad/ /'grub pa'i nges med 'grub kyang chags sdang rgyu/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba thong bar byin gyis rlobs/ ma shi bar la nges par chos byed snyam du bsam zhing lag tu len pa /sdig spyod rnam g.yengs chos lugs ngan pa dang / /don med bya ba spangs nas dam pa'i chos/ /tshul bzhin rgyud la sbyar te rtse gcig tu/ /dal 'byor snying po len par byin gyis rlobs/ mi dge ba'i 'bras bu bsams pa /ngan song sdug bsngal thams cad bskyed pa'i rgyu/ rgyu /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug sems kyis 'phangs/ /lus ngag yid kyi sdig pa mi dge bcus/ /dug can zas bzhin de spong bar bsams pa 'dor bar byin gyis rlobs/

dge ba'i 'bras bu /phan bde'i bsam pa dag pa'i sbyin dge ba'i las bsam pa pa dang / /tshul khrims bzod brtson bsam gtan shes rab sogs/ /sgo gsum dge ba bcu po dpag med la/ de bsgrub par bsam pa /nyin mtshan chos kyis 'da' bar byin gyis rlobs/ lung ma bstan gyi las /za nyal gnyid dang 'gro 'dug la sogs pa/ /lung ma bstan gyi bya ba thams cad kyang / /dran dang shes bzhin bag yod ldan pa yis/ de dag dge bar kha lo bsgyur ba /thams cad dge bar bsgyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ dge sdig gi las cha mthun la 'bad kyang 'khor ba las mi thar bas thar pa cig nges par bsgrub dgos par bsam pa /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mi rtag snying po med/ /btson ra me 'obs zo chu'i 'khor lo bzhin/ /mtha' med 'khyams pa'i nyams thag 'di mthong nas/ 'khor pa ma zhen pa'o /thar pa nges par bsgrub par byin gyis rlobs/ /thog med dus nas 'gro drug sems can rnams/ /dgra gnyen thams cad pha mar shes byas nas/ /bde dang bde ba'i rgyu la 'god byed cing / byams pa bsgom pa /tshad med phan bdes tshim par byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag gi drin can ma rnams 'khor ba na/ /nyon mongs sdig dang sdug bsngal mi bzad gzir/ /dge ba'i lam stor ma rig mun par 'khyams/ snying rje bsgom pa /sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras sel bar byin gyis rlobs/ /sdug bsngal gsum gyis gdungs pa'i sems can rnams/ gnas skabs mthar thug bde la 'god pa'i phyir/ /srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' la mi gnas par/ smon pa byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgrub par byin gyis rlobs/ /bde ba 'dod dang sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa/ /bdag gzhan sems can thams cad mnyam lags na/ /bde dge thams cad sems can gzhan la ster/ bdag gzhan brje ba bsgom pa /sdig sdug bdag gis len par byin gyis rlobs/

de'i spyod pa la bslab pa /byang chub sems gnyis nges par bsgom pa na/ /nad gdon dgra bgegs bde sdug sna tshogs rkyen/ /gces 'dzin dgra bo 'dul ba'i dpa' bo yin/ bdag don la ma zhen pa'o /rkyen ngan grogs su 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ don dam byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa /chos kun rmi lam bzhin du rang gi sems/ de yang /chu zla bzhin du snang yang sgyu mar rang bzhin med/ /brag cha bzhin du 'gro 'ong gnas med pas/ de yang rten 'brel/ dbyer med pa /gnas lugs mtshan la ma zhen pa'o brjod bral rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ don dam /chos nyid de bzhin nyid du dbyer med pa'i cha cing / kun rdzob /chos can mtshan nyid sna tshogs su snang ba'i cha rten 'brel gyi/ rten 'brel /yan lag bcu gnyis lugs 'byung lugs ldog las 'khor ba las mya ngan las 'das pa gnad/ /'khor 'das rgyu rkyen rten 'brel rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /sems nyid sna tshogs su gsal dang stong pa gnyis zung du 'jug la/ /rgyu lam 'bras bu'i gnas skabs kyi rang bzhin chos rnams ma lus pa/ rgyu /ma dag nyams 'di dang dag pa'i 'bras bu snang ba ru/ bya lus zag bcas dang sems rtog bcas/ /spang rtogs mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobs/ rgyu/ thabs/ 'bras bu gsum dang / /rgyud gsum lung / gdam ngag bla ma/ nyams myong / tshad ma bzhi yis nges par rtogs/ /gdams ngag drug dang snyan rgyud bzhi po tshig don brda lag len yis/ /rten 'brel lnga po phyi/ nang / gsang ba/ de kho na nyid/ mthar thug lus dang sems la 'grig thabs shes thun mong gi bar chad gsum las grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ rlung / thig le/ rtsa yi ge /'khrid lugs gsum dang lam lnga dang byang phyogs so bdun ltar bgrod lugs gnyis shes nas/

las 'phro/ mos gus/ brtson 'grus/ /'du lugs gsum dang gnas lugs gsum po sems gnas lugs gsum te/ rlung log bdag byin gyis rlabs/ brten mnyam 'dres so yis/ /drod gsum rnam rtog khams dgu thig le/ byung rgyal btang dang mi btang ba'i gnad bzhi/ /nyams bco lnga kyi bye brag shes par byin gyis rlobs/ khams/ rlung log rlung rengs/ /'dus pa gsum la mthong snang / thig le 'bar ba/ stong pa dgra langs/ bde ba/ rgyas pa/ nyam nga 'phrang bdun man ngag bdun/ stong pa dang bde bas brgyal ba'i /skyon rnams dran pa nyer bzhag yang dag spong ba bzhis yon tan k+ṣa yig gi bar chad hūm̐ ring gis dngos grub len/ nyams thams cad rang gis /rlung sems gyi rten 'brel du shes pas phyi'i ngo bo grub/ bar chad kyi re dogs bral/ mtshan nyid sna tshogs rang bzhin stong pa nyid dbyer med pa'i ngo bo /zung 'jug ye shes skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ rgyu la gnas pa /zag bcas rtsa lus yi ge ngag khams sems dang rlung ye shes bzhi/ dbang las thob pa/ /dbang bzhis smin cing lam la goms pa/ rim gnyis bsgoms pa yis/ /lta ba bzhi/ 'dra ba nyams su myong ba grub mtha' bzhi nyams su myong zhing grub mtha' la rtags su shar ba/ rtags su shar/ 'bras bu la mngon du gyur pa/ /sku lnga mngon du gyur rang gi che ba'o par dag pa'i snang ba'o byin gyis rlobs/ /deng nas 'khor ba ma stongs bar dag du/ /mthong thos dran reg sems can ma lus pa/ /thabs mchog dpag med rgyun chad med pa yis/ /sangs rgyas sa la 'god par byin gyis rlobs/ /ces gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la snying nas gsol ba 'debs pa dngos grub bsam 'phel zhes bya ba/

'khrid kyi lam rim dang sbyar te tshigs su bcad pa sum cu rtsa dgu pa 'di ni/ dmigs pa med pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rje'i mnga' bdag bka' drin gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa de nyid kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs shing / de nyid kyi slob bu'i tha chung du gyur pa brtson 'grus spangs pa'i rnal 'byor pa puṇ+ya in+d+ras rang bzo'i skyon spangs te/ gtso bo rang gi kha ton dang / chos kyi bu dang rang gi tsha bo la sogs pa'i skal ba dang ldan pa'i slob ma rnams la phan pa'i lhag bsam rnam par dag pa dang ldan pas/ sā dhā ra ṇā ste thun mong zhes pa lcags pho khyi'i lo hor zla gsum pa'i dkar phyogs dga' ba dang po'i tshes la/ rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal po'i bsti gnas dam pa gzhis ka bsam grub rtse'i yang steng dga' ldan chos kyi pho brang chen por legs par bgyis pa'i dge bas/ gsung ngag rin po che'i bstan pa phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas pa dang / sems can thams cad la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig ces pa'i yi ge pa ni rnam par dpyod pa'i blo gros kyi mig rab tu gsal ba'i rnal 'byor pa rin chen 'brug rgyas kyis dad gus kyis kun nas blangs te bgyis pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 6 puṇ+ya.in+d+ras/ lam 'bras brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 5
